mentions.name: Microlandia
mentions.description: A city builder game with a detailed urban simulation that has sold nearly 10,000 copies; current development adds modeling of energy, climate, and new policies such as universal basic income, with the solo developer now collaborating with 2D, 3D, and music artists.
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue to work on my city builder game Microlandia, launched here in HN ~6 months ago. I originally predicted a few dozen urbanism nerds would play it, but now almost 10,000 copies sold.
